title: Auto Loans: combining discounts into the enrolled APR, the cap and the floor
content:
# Auto Loans: combining discounts into the enrolled APR, the cap and the floor

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower enrolls an auto loan in autopay from one of their PCB checking accounts. It fixes how the discounts combine into the APR recorded with the enrollment.

## Clause

The relationship discount and the autopay discount are first added together into one total discount. That total is capped at the product's discount cap, and the capped total is subtracted **once** from the rate before discounts. When the figure so obtained is below the product's APR floor, the new APR is the floor. The APR is rounded to two decimal places. The list of discounts is recorded as autopay and relationship, autopay, relationship or none, according to the discounts included.

## Order of operations

1. Add the relationship discount (if it applies) and the autopay discount (if it is added).
2. Cap that total at the discount cap.
3. Subtract the capped total once from the rate before discounts.
4. If below the APR floor, use the floor.
5. Round to two decimal places.

## Witness case (illustrative figures, not product values)

Illustrative settings: relationship discount 0.30, autopay discount 0.30, discount cap 0.40, APR floor 5.00. Rate before discounts 7.10; both discounts apply.

| Reading | New APR | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Subtract each discount in turn, uncapped | 6.50 | wrong: the two are totalled and the total is capped |
| Total 0.60, capped to 0.40, subtracted once | 6.70 | correct |

## Further hypothetical cases (same illustrative settings)

| Rate before discounts | Discounts included | New APR | List recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7.10 | relationship only | 6.80 | relationship |
| 7.10 | autopay only | 6.80 | autopay |
| 7.10 | neither | 7.10 | none |

Floor case: with a rate before discounts of 5.30 and both discounts applying, 5.30 less the capped 0.40 is 4.90, which is below the floor, so the new APR is 5.00.
